about_the_game:
Create the computer company you always dreamed of


You start with a little office, a bit of cash, and one big idea. From there? That's up to you. In PC Tycoon 2 you design your own processors, graphics cards, laptops and monitors, write your own operating system, and go up against rival companies for a slice of the market — building a tiny startup into a global tech giant along the way.

It's meant to be easy to pick up and genuinely relaxing. Tweak a component, ship it, see how it sells, then pour the profits into something bigger. There's always one more thing to improve, one more product to release, one more rival to overtake — and before you know it, an hour's gone.

What you'll get up to

  • Design your own hardware — set the specs and the look of your CPUs, GPUs, motherboards, RAM, drives, laptops and monitors
  • Build your own operating system and see how the market reacts to it
  • Grow your company — work your way up through 10 office tiers, expand the factory, hire great people, and spend big on marketing
  • Outplay the competition — rival companies are busy developing their own products, so stay ahead of them… or just buy them out
  • Research over 3000 technologies and unlock better parts as you go
  • Flip on Challenging mode if you want the economy to actually fight back

A quick word from me

Hi — I'm an indie developer, and I make and support PC Tycoon 2 entirely on my own. Just so you know what to expect: this is a fun, casual, relaxing tycoon, not a hardcore hardware simulator. Come in for a chilled-out empire-builder and I think you'll really enjoy your time with it. Thanks so much for checking it out — every player honestly means a lot to me! ❤️

  • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
